text: oliver: Quick FYI 1: I ran the site-wide linkcheck after the MDX migration and we have a cluster of fragment failures where headings that immediately follow a non-heading block (image/table/blockquote/code fence) are getting dedupe suffixes (-1, -2). Estimated ~18 pages. megan: Wow. Any reproducible example? oliver: Minimal repro from docs/guides/deploy.md: ```markdown ![flow](./assets/deploy-flow.svg) ### Deployment checklist - build - validate ``` When built, the h3 id becomes deployment-checklist-1. Links to #deployment-checklist fail. rebecca: I can repro locally with mkdocs-material and with docusaurus plugin. Linkcheck output looks like: ``` [linkcheck] ERROR: Fragment not found: https://docs.redwood.ai/guides/deploy#deployment-checklist [docusaurus] ERROR in plugin-content-docs: anchor not found for marker \"#deployment-checklist\" ``` kai: Short-term options: 1) insert explicit HTML anchors before problematic headings, 2) switch to explicit slug syntax when heading supports it (### Foo {#foo}), or 3) update all incoming links to match deduped slugs. I prefer (1) for minimal public-URL churn. oliver: Agreed. Quick patch example I pushed to a tiny branch: ```html ### Deployment checklist ``` This restores the predictable fragment without touching tooling. megan: Good. Can you also add a short note to docs/migration/MDX-HEADING-DEDUPE.md explaining the pattern and recommending anchors when a heading follows media/fenced blocks/tables? That will save reviewers time. rebecca: I'll take the repo sweep and the PR: plan = 1) grep for candidate pages (image/fence/table -> heading), 2) apply anchors to top 20 high-traffic pages, 3) open PR with changelog and migration note. Grep I'll use: `git grep -n "^!\[\|^>\|^\|\|^```" docs/ | xargs -I{} sed -n '1,6p' {}` (will refine). kai: We should also add a CI regression: scan built docs for links that reference an id that is not present in the rendered HTML and fail fast. That'll catch this class next time. I can file a ticket for docs-infra. oliver: docs-bot created a preview for my quick-fix branch: https://deploy-preview-1288--staging.docs.redwood.ai/guides/deploy (build 1288) :white_check_mark: linkcheck passes for that page. docs-bot: PR opened: redwood/docs#3310 1 1 1 1 (assigns: rebecca; reviewers: megan, kai) megan: Thanks rebecca. After the PR merges please run `npm run linkcheck -- --full` and paste summary here. If we see more, we'll batch them into small PRs rather than a massive churn. rebecca: Will do. Also adding a note in the migration doc: "Headings that immediately follow block-level media (images, tables, blockquotes, fenced code) may receive dedupe suffixes after MDX migration. If linking externally, add an explicit anchor or use an explicit slug." kai: Filing follow-up: adjust slugify plugin to keep consistent behavior across mkdocs and docusaurus (ticket DOCS-712). Add unit test for media->heading pattern. oliver: :thumbsup: Nice small wins. Let's run a full site linkcheck after the quick fixes land and then close out the triage board. megan: Agreed. Thanks all.
